Uber Co-Founder Kalanick Teases Protest at Nvidia as Calls for Huang’s Return Continue

Nvidia board said Jensen Huang won’t come back as CEO, but some of his Silicon Valley peers are still pushing the idea

By

Uber co-founder Travis Kalanick walked on stage at an investor conference in Austin, Texas, wearing a black leather jacket. Next to him was Antonio Gracias, close friend and longtime investor of Elon Musk —also in a black jacket.

“Yours looks a lot like Jensen’s,” said Gracias, referring to Nvidia NVDA -3.30 % decrease; down pointing triangle co-founder Jensen Huang, who had made a black leather jacket his uniform and was ousted last week as chief executive of the chip maker.
